title: Pushout of an extension is postcomposition in Ext
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $S:0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence in $X\text{-\operatorname{Modules}}$, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf]. For every morphism $\varphi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal W$, the pushout short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal W\to\mathcal B\amalg_{\mathcal A}\mathcal W\to\mathcal C\to0$ has Yoneda class $\varphi[1]\circ\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal W)$, where $\delta$ is the Yoneda class of $S$.

source.place: Homology Section Tag 010I, pushout of extensions; Derived Section Tag 06XP, functoriality of Ext composition

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pushout-short-exact-sequence] in the abelian category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules to the given short exact sequence and $\varphi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal W$. It constructs the pushout $\mathcal B\amalg_{\mathcal A}\mathcal W$, the projection to $\mathcal C$, and a short exact pushout sequence; its canonical maps form a morphism of short exact sequences whose first component is $\varphi$ and whose third component is $\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$.

source.place: Homology Section Tag 010I, item (2) after the definition of Ext

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-p1-ext-class-naturality] to this morphism of short exact sequences. With first component $\varphi$ and third component the identity, its naturality equation says that the original extension class postcomposed by $\varphi[1]$ equals the extension class of the pushout sequence, since composition with the identity on $\mathcal C$ is unchanged. Reordering the equality gives the displayed Yoneda class formula.

statement_change.old_statement: Let $X$ be a ringed space and let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with Yoneda class $\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf]. For every morphism $\varphi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal W$, the pushout short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal W\to\mathcal B\amalg_{\mathcal A}\mathcal W\to\mathcal C\to0$ has Yoneda class $\varphi[1]\circ\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal W)$.
statement_change.what: The original statement quantified over an arbitrary ringed space and used Ext/Yoneda classes for O_X-modules, but the cited dependency def-sc-ext-sheaf defines Ext only for schemes and the category X.Modules; consequently the statement was not typable. The correction specializes X to a scheme and the modules to X.Modules, preserving the pushout class formula.
